## Notes

Overtaken, not missing: **1b, 4, 5** are retired. Don's 2026-10-01 ruling on F059 criterion 5 (Airbnb precedent) replaced an inline toggle with a pill that floats and stays visible while scrolling under 1024px, side by side from 1024px, and a switch docked in the filter bar only with the owner panel open; it also says nothing is inserted between rows of results. The old report called these a spec conflict; a dated ruling now settles them, so they are retired and shown, not counted. What still holds is **1a** (no full-width segmented bar), **2** and **3** (the switch works). Criterion 2's "toggle shows map active" holds for the docked tab (`aria-selected`); the phone dock names the next view, as the ruled pill does.

Reviewed: T116 had no PR; #279 carries no `Reviewed by:`; #479 and #496 are `review-skipped` [V]. Shipped: `deploy-health` is green on the merge commits of #279 (18948ae), #479 (3c49027) and #496 (0cee585) [V]; T116 has no run, so `unknown`. PM looked: no closed `uat` Issue ticks these boxes [V]. No `guards F044` marker exists anywhere [V grep].
